title: About Blue Air Room Section
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 74 recent saved-signal files and 59 captured links, then narrowed the page to 9 source windows around @compositioning: Drawings by Jans Muskee (2014-2025) and @0xJoain: Gm, available works➕➕➕, plus 7 more. A source image from pbs.twimg.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became Blue Air Room Section: Wide architectural section, a painterly room cutaway with vertical strips: left hazy glass opening to cyan pool air and hedge green, central black curtain slab, right matte gray wall with tiny framed inset. One-point corridor cues and rail diagonals stitch depth through broad empty plaster. After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 9 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against luminous cyan pool aperture, central black curtain textile cut, and small dark green wall inset.
